tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a durable memory (a fact, preference, decision, or note) so it persists across sessions. Call this whenever the user tells you something worth remembering long-term.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Semantic search over your stored memories — finds relevant notes by meaning, not just keywords (e.g. a query about "deployment" surfaces a memory that says "ships on Cloudflare Workers"). Call this at the start of a task, or whenever you might have prior context about the user, project, or topic.

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: List the most recently stored/updated memories in this space.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete a memory by its id (from a previous recall/list result).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "recall" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search your stored memories for anything relevant to a query. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
